TideCave_Text_Npc0.en: Rare fish hide in the deep. Bring a\nGOOD ROD.
TideCave_Text_Npc0.fr: Les poissons rares se cachent dans\nles profondeurs. Apporte une CANNE.

TideCave_Text_Npc1.en: SEADRA, RELICANTH... the sea keeps\nits treasures.
TideCave_Text_Npc1.fr: HYPOCÉAN, RELICANTH… la mer garde\nses trésors.

TideCave_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A PEARL for my collection, a MYSTIC\nWATER for you.
TideCave_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Une PERLE pour ma collection, une\nEAU MYSTIQUE pour toi.

TideCave_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
TideCave_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

TideCave_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

TideCave_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
TideCave_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

TideCave_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
TideCave_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
